title: You Wrapped It, You're In!
about: A Christmas wrapping tradition where making a gift hard to open means joining the family club.
description: A Christmas wrapping tradition where making a gift hard to open means joining the family club.
lyrics: And we've got one little law.
That's the easy part, you see,
For our crazy family!Some folks wrap with ribbons,
But there's a special group of us,
You can keep it nice and simple,
With some paper and some string,
But make one present hard to open,
And you've joined a whole new thing!Chorus
Now you're joining in the fun!
And there's no backing out again!
If you make a gift impossible,
You're in the club, my friend!Verse 2
One year a gift was frozen,
In a solid block of ice,
At the chaos that we cause!You might get fifty layers,
Or a box inside a box,
When your present comes with locks!Pre-Chorus
Or the money that you spend,
While you're laughing with your friends!Chorus
Now you're joining in the fun!
And there's no backing out again!
If you make a gift impossible,
You're in the club, my friend!Verse 3
Now the normal folks are smiling,
While the rest of us are wondering,
There's a gift that weighs a hundred pounds,
Just to get the wrapping down!The paper's flying everywhere,
Next December's gift of doom!Bridge – Spoken, playful
"Now, just so everybody understands the rules..."
"Simple, right?"Pause."But if you decide to get creative..."
"And make that present hard to open..."
What started as a little joke,
Is what we do to all our friends!Outro – Spoken
